parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description_zh: 可指定单个域名，指定单个域名的情况下，仅查询该域名关联的白名单回源节点的回源IP段。若不指定域名，则查询所有白名单回源节点的回源IP段。
parameters.description_en: The domain name. You can specify only one domain name in each request. If you do not specify this parameter, the origin CIDR blocks of all domain names in your account in the whitelist are returned.
